title: Monodromy data
statement:
The tuple consisting of $\rho$, the geometric group
$H_{\mathrm{geom}}$, the locally finite-type extension
$G_{\mathrm{arith}}(\rho)$, and the degree components $G^{[m]}$ is
called the *monodromy data* of the lisse Weil sheaf. The term
``arithmetic monodromy group'' below always means this degree-graded
extension, with grading as in [lem-wf-degree-components-grading]; its
image in $\operatorname{GL}(V)$ has the Zariski closures
described in [lem-wf-degree-component-image].

blueprint_update.statement:
For a represented degree datum $\rho$ ([d-monodromy]), the tuple
consisting of $\rho$, the geometric monodromy group $H$, the locally
finite-type extension $G_{\mathrm{arith}}(\rho)$, and the degree
components $G^{[m]}$ is called the *monodromy data* of $\rho$. The term
*arithmetic monodromy group* below always means this degree-graded
extension, with grading as in [lem-wf-degree-components-grading].

Its image in $\operatorname{GL}_n$ has as Zariski closures the
translates $HF^m$ of the degree components.

lean.note: Existing represented degree datum with its canonically attached monodromy tuple, explicitly identified in the module blueprint documentation as def-wf-monodromy-data. The arithmetic factor here is ArithmeticMonodromyExtension (the degree-retaining semidirect product on k-points), not arithmeticMonodromy (the finite-type Zariski closure of the full matrix image). The listed declarations supply each tuple factor, its grading and matrix-image closures, using the exact interfaces of all five statement dependencies.
